Max: hey team, max here, first day on runtime. trying to build from source on ubuntu 24.04 with CUDA 11.8 and gcc-12, hitting a ptxas error at link. any quick onboarding tips?
Max: error:
```
ptxas fatal : ValueError: unsupported PTX version '8.7'
collect2: error: ld returned 1 exit status
```
Max: building with `make -j6 BUILD_USE_CUDA=1` on main branch
Mika: welcome! quick checks: `nvcc --version`, `nvidia-smi`, `which ptxas` and `ptxas --version`. driver < toolkit is the usual culprit.
Max: nvcc -> release 11.8 V11.8.89, nvidia-smi -> Driver Version: 520.31.01, which ptxas -> /usr/local/cuda-11.8/bin/ptxas, ptxas --version -> 10.6.0
Natanael: yep driver 520.x likely can't consume newer PTX. If you can't upgrade drivers, set `TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST` to only the SMs your GPU supports to avoid emitting PTX v8.7. e.g. `export TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST="8.6;8.0;7.5"` or add `CUDA_NVCC_FLAGS='-gencode arch=compute_86,code=sm_86'`.
Max: set TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST to sm_86, rebuild -> moves past ptxas but now linker fails: `undefined reference to cublasLtCreate`
Rosie: that one is link order/missing lib. ensure `-lcublasLt` is in LDFLAGS and ordered before `-lcublas`/`-lcudart`. also confirm `/usr/local/cuda-11.8/lib64/libcublasLt.so` exists.
Max: libcublasLt.so is present. changed Makefile link order to `-lcublasLt -lcublas -lcudart` and re-ran -> build finishes! :tada:
Max: thanks all, i'll add a short onboarding note: check driver vs toolkit, TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST fallback, and the cublasLt link-order gotcha. will paste commands I used in eng-runtime docs.
Mika: great, ping me and i'll fold it into the onboarding doc. welcome aboard :wave:
infra-bot: recommended dev image for consistent builds: registry.redwood/internal/runtime-dev:cuda11.8-gcc12-2026-03-20
Max: awesome, thanks everyone, saves my morning :)
